inputs.value: ASSET: a limestone block wall with a heavy arched wooden door with iron studs set into it.
ART STYLE: detailed 16-bit pixel art. Crisp square pixels, dark outlines, soft cel shading with light dithering, slightly chunky proportions. No blur, no smooth gradients.
WORLD: dark fantasy. Crypts, stone ruins, candlelight, worn iron and old bone. Use only these colours and close tints of them: #2b1e3d, #4a3168, #7b4fa8, #c09bd8, #f2e3c6.

RULES: a section of wall with a door or window set into it, viewed perfectly front-on, orthographic elevation, completely flat, no perspective, no depth, no floor or ceiling visible. A door reaches down to the very bottom edge of the image. The wall at the far left edge and far right edge is plain so it joins neighbouring plain wall panels. Flat even colour on the wall: no gradients, no lighting. Fills the frame edge to edge. No furniture, no shadows, no border, no text.
